text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to authorize the prohibition of U-turns on Glengrove Avenue West, between Rosewell Avenue and Glen Castle Street and on Rosewell Avenue, between Glengrove Avenue West and Cheritan Avenue. These streets are adjacent to John Ross Robertson Junior Public School and Glenview Senior Public School. The proposed prohibitions will enhance the safety for pedestrians destined to/from these two schools and will enhance the flow of traffic on the subject sections of Glengrove Avenue West and Rosewell Avenue.

North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited eastbound and westbound U-turn movements at all times on Glengrove Avenue West, between Rosewell Avenue and Glen Castle Street. 2. Prohibited northbound and southbound U-turn movements at all times on Rosewell Avenue, between Glengrove Avenue West and Cheritan Avenue.
